verdict.rationale: GitHub explicitly markets Projects as a way to 'organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks' and to 'create issues and manage projects with tools that adapt to your code,' directly matching the story. However, evidence is limited to marketing copy without deeper feature detail (views, roadmap timelines, hierarchy) or independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of roadmap/table/board views, independent user validation of project board usage at scale.
